citations.short: Procedures not  in writing, fully followed
citations.long: The responsibilities and procedures applicable to the quality control unit are not in writing.

citations.short: Buildings not maintained in good state of repair
citations.long: Buildings used in the manufacturing, processing, packing, and holding of a drug product are not maintained in a good state of repair.
Equipment and utensils are not cleaned at appropriate intervals to prevent contamination that would alter the safety, identity, strength, quality or purity of the drug product.

Written procedures for cleaning and maintenance fail to include maintenance and cleaning schedules, description in sufficient detail of methods, equipment and materials used, description in sufficient detail of the methods of disassembling and reassembling equipment as necessary to assure proper cleaning and maintenance, and instructions for removal or obliteration of previous batch identification.

There are no written procedures for production and process controls designed to assure that the drug products have the identity, strength, quality, and purity they purport or are represented to possess.
Written production and process control procedures are not followed in the execution of production and process control functions.
Procedures describing the warehousing of drug products are not established.
Drug products are not stored under appropriate conditions of temperature so that their identity, strength, quality, and purity are not affected.

citations.short: Sampling and testing plans not followed
citations.long: Written procedures for sampling and testing plans are not followed for each drug product.
There is no written testing program designed to assess the stability characteristics of drug products.

citations.short: Results not used for expiration dates, storage cond.
citations.long: Results of stability testing are not used in determining expiration dates.
The batch production and control records are deficient in that they are not an accurate reproduction of the appropriate master production or control record.

citations.short: Investigations made into any unexplained discrepancy
citations.long: Batch production and control records do not include the results of any investigation made into any unexplained discrepancy, whether or not the batch of drug product had already been distributed.
Equipment used in the manufacture, processing, packing or holding of drug products is not of appropriate design, of adequate size, and suitably located to facilitate operations for its intended use.
Each lot of a component liable to objectionable microbiological contamination is deficiently subjected to microbiological tests before use.
There is a failure to thoroughly review any unexplained discrepancy whether or not the batch has been already distributed.

citations.short: Reason for Not Conducting Complaint Investigation
citations.long: Complaint records are deficient in that they do not document the reason and the individual making the decision not to conduct a complaint investigation.

citations.short: Procedures not  in writing, fully followed
citations.long: The responsibilities and procedures applicable to the quality control unit are not in writing.
GMP training is not conducted on a continuing basis to assure that employees remain familiar with CGMP requirements applicable to them.
Employees are not given training in the particular operations they perform as part of their function.
Equipment used in the manufacture, processing, packing or holding of drug products is not of appropriate design, of adequate size, and suitably located to facilitate operations for its intended use.

citations.short: Quarantine of Rejected Components et. al.
citations.long: Rejected closures are not controlled under a quarantine system designed to prevent their use in manufacturing or processing operations for which they are unsuitable.
Procedures describing the warehousing of drug products are not established.
The establishment of specifications and test procedures including any changes thereto, are not drafted by the appropriate organizational unit and reviewed and approved by the quality control unit.

citations.short: Calibration - at intervals, written program, remedial action
citations.long: The calibration of instruments is not done at suitable intervals in accordance with an established written program and with provisions for remedial action in the event accuracy and/or precision limits are not met.

citations.short: Complete test data included in records
citations.long: Laboratory records do not include complete data derived from all tests, examinations and assay necessary to assure compliance with established specifications and standards.

Laboratory records do not include the initials or signature of a second person showing that the original records have been reviewed for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with established standards.
